kitchen.title: Commercial Kitchen
kitchen.description: Commercial kitchens require specialized ventilation for heat, smoke, and grease removal. Makeup air is critical to replace exhausted air and maintain building pressure.

requirements.specialConsiderations: Fire safety, grease management, makeup air required, negative pressure control
